title: In Search Of Sita
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: In Search of Sita is an Amar Chitra Katha special edition comic that re-examines the timeless epic of the Ramayana completely from the perspective of its central heroine, Sita.

title: Durga Das
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Durgadas (Vol. 739) is a biographical Amar Chitra Katha comic written by Ramesh Sinha that celebrates the legendary heroism of Durgadas Rathore, a 17th-century Rajput general from Marwar.

title: Bikal The Terrible
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Bikal the Terrible (Vol. 667) is an Amar Chitra Katha comic featuring two humorous tribal folktales from Madhya Pradesh centered around the theme of brain over brawn.

title: The Lost Prince
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Lost Prince is a fascinating Amar Chitra Katha comic that tells a Tibetan Buddhist folk tale originally compiled from ancient monastic legends.

title: Andher Nagari
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Andher Nagari (Vol. 272) is a satirical Amar Chitra Katha comic adapted from the legendary 1881 Hindi play Andher Nagari Chaupat Raja by Bharatendu Harishchandra, the father of modern Hindi prose.

title: Kunwar Singh
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Kunwar Singh (Vol. 751) is a biographical Amar Chitra Katha comic that chronicles the incredible heroism of the 75-year-old Rajput ruler from Jagdishpur, Bihar, who spearheaded the Indian Rebellion of 1857 in his region.

title: The Elusive Kaka
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Elusive Kaka (Vol. 816) is an Amar Chitra Katha comic adapted from Kakana Kote, a famous classic Kannada play by the legendary writer Masti Venkatesha Iyengar.

title: Thanedar Hasan Askari
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: Thanedar Hasan Askari (Vol. 286) is an Amar Chitra Katha comic featuring the real-life biographical episodes of an extraordinary, highly principled, and eccentric police inspector who served in Uttar Pradesh during the 1930s.

title: The Fool's Disciples
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Fool's Disciples (Vol. 713) is an Amar Chitra Katha comic adaptation of a classic 17th-century Tamil satire written by Costanzo Beschi, an Italian Jesuit priest who settled in Madurai.

title: The Prophecy
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Prophecy (Vol. 291) is an Amar Chitra Katha comic featuring a unique Tibetan Buddhist folk tale originally preserved in ancient mountain monasteries.

title: The Taming of Gulla
author: Author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Taming of Gulla (Vol. 282) is an Amar Chitra Katha comic based on a classic Kannada story by the eminent writer Gorur Ramaswamy Iyengar.

title: The Celestial Necklace
author: Author:
description: When Queen Chellana accidentally breaks the necklace and demands it be mended, the story unfolds into a profound lesson about honouring promises, duty, and fate as someone risks death to fix it.

title: The Rainbow Prince
author: Author:
description: The Rainbow Prince is a Bengali folk tale about a spoiled princess whose obsessive search for a legendary prince trapped in a parrot teaches her a harsh lesson in humility.

title: Thugsen
description: Thugsen is a classic Maharashtrian folktale about a young prince who learns the arts of disguise and trickery from his mother's loyal maid.
author: Amar Chitra Katha
